# Chequered Ink Cartoon UI Pack

Selected reusable UI elements from the free Cartoon UI Pack.

## Imported originals

- `basic-white/button-wider-idle.png`
- `basic-white/button-wider-hover.png`
- `basic-white/button-wider-clicked.png`
- `basic-white/pop-up-window.png`
- `basic-blue/pop-up-window.png`
- `basic-blue/button-square-idle.png`
- `basic-blue/button-wider-idle.png`
- `basic-blue/icon-panel-big.png`
- `basic-blue/icon-cross.png`
- `basic-blue/arrow-left.png`
- `basic-blue/icon-restart.png`
- `basic-orange/ribbon.png`

The files in `original/` are preserved as downloaded. Project-facing
copies replace the shared Pizza Rush button, text-box, popup panel,
popup title, gameplay controls, and navigation sprites while retaining
their existing Unity GUIDs. Domain-specific item icons remain mapped to
their original meanings (tile, hammer, freeze, saw, coffee, and magic).

## Unity normalization

- Texture Type: Sprite (2D and UI)
- Mesh Type: Full Rect
- Alpha is Transparency: enabled
- Button and text-box borders: 24 px
- Popup borders: 32 px
- Square gameplay button borders: 18 px
- Wide gameplay panel borders: 24 px
- Navigation icons: no slicing
- UI Image Type: Sliced for resizable panels

Checked: 2026-07-30
